description: Juicy, tender poached chicken breasts for shredding, slicing, salads and meal prep.

ingredients.name: cold water or low-sodium chicken broth

notes:
A gentle simmer is the key to tender chicken; a hard boil tightens the meat and makes it rubbery.
Frozen breasts work too: add about 50% more simmering time and check the temperature.
Strain and save the cooking liquid as a light stock for soups or rice.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge; store shredded chicken with a splash of the broth to stay moist.

source.label: Cooking question in the Recipes chat

steps.text: Lower the heat to a gentle simmer (small bubbles, not a rolling boil), cover, and cook until the thickest part reads 165°F on an instant-read thermometer, about 12–15 minutes.
steps.title: Simmer gently

steps.text: Move the chicken to a cutting board and rest 5 minutes before slicing or shredding with two forks.
steps.title: Rest

description: Trader Joe's frozen artichoke bottoms filled with wild rice, lentils, garlicky kale and feta, broiled with Grana Padano.

notes:
Wild rice replaces the quinoa one-for-one. About 3 tbsp dry wild rice yields roughly ½ cup cooked; precooked or frozen wild rice skips the first step.
Garlic powder, extra virgin olive oil and the Grana Padano amount are estimates, since the original post didn't list them.
